name: clinvar
description: ClinVar's VCF of variants with clinical assertions, as published by NCBI for one genome build, with a tabix index built on arrival and a record of the fetch. The tag is the date NCBI last changed the file, so a genome can hold several weekly releases side by side. Registered only after its contigs and coordinates were checked against this genome's own sequence names and lengths (bin/prepare_resource.py); what that check found, including any records on sequences this genome does not have, is in the asset's provenance file. The VCF itself is byte-for-byte the published file, and was verified against NCBI's posted md5.

required_files.description: the fetch record and compatibility summary

required_assets.description: the genome whose coordinates the variants are in
